//: The local scripts are plain Node ESM, and they were invisible to the linter:
the repository's ESLint config uses the TypeScript project service, and a
file that no tsconfig includes fails to load with "was not found by the
project service". Every script in this directory therefore produced a
parsing error and the repo-wide lint (`pnpm exec eslint . --max-warnings 0`,
the command the CI build-gate job runs) was red.
This project gives the linter a project to load them from. `checkJs` is on
so the type-aware rules have real types to work with, and `noEmit` is on
because the scripts are executed by `node`, never compiled.
